heads.en: The Ai era is only about stability and fear of being eliminated! In the face of uncertainty, many think of risks and failures in the first place, but sometimes they really limit themselves, not because they lack capacity, but because they are afraid to walk out of the familiar environment. Psychologists, however, put forward the concept of a 22% horizon, suggesting that in a familiar life, a part of the time is reserved to challenge strange things, to learn and expand life possibilities through adaptation changes. An hour ago, I was just trying to be safe and I was afraid of being eliminated! I'm going out of my comfort zone to get my confidence back.
